title: The Alt-Right Playbook: The Card Says Moops
summary: An Innuendo Studios video essay from the Alt-Right Playbook series that uses the Seinfeld 'the card says moops' scene to explain bad-faith argument tactics. It describes how reactionaries use sincerity and irony as shields in online debate.
why: HN commenters recommend the series for understanding bad-faith 'just kidding' dynamics and trolling online.

quote.text: I can only recommend watching Innuendo Studios' _Alt-Right Playbook_ series for a deeper understanding of the dynamics
